title: Business Motion to take AI transition motion after SWDA Bill
what_it_is: A Business Motion moved by the Deputy Leader of the House to rearrange the order of business so that a Private Member's Motion on an AI transition with no jobless growth is taken immediately after proceedings on the Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA) Bill.
why_it_matters: The record does not set out the practical impact.

key_points.point: Mr Zaqy Mohamad moved that, notwithstanding Standing Order 26, the Private Member's Motion on 'An Artificial Intelligence (AI) Transition with No Jobless Growth' be taken immediately after proceedings on the SWDA Bill have concluded.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: That notwithstanding Standing Order 26, the Private Member's Motion on 'An Artificial Intelligence (AI) Transition with No Jobless Growth' be taken immediately after the proceedings on the Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA) Bill have been concluded.

key_points.point: He said that under the Standing Orders, the Introduction of Government Bills ordinarily takes precedence over a Private Member's Motion.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: Under the Standing Orders, the Introduction of Government Bills ordinarily takes precedence over a Private Member's Motion.

key_points.point: He said that in the ordinary course, the Private Member's Motion would have been dealt with only after all six Bills on the Order Paper had been completed.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: In the ordinary course, therefore, the Private Member's Motion would have been dealt with only after all six Bills on the Order Paper have been completed.

key_points.point: He sought the rearrangement because the subject matter of the SWDA Bill and the Private Member's Motion both pertain to jobs, employment and workforce development, and have common or related issues.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: the subject matter of the SWDA Bill and the Private Member's Motion both pertain to jobs, employment and workforce development, and have common or related issues.

key_points.point: He said it would be convenient and expedient to have them debated back-to-back so that the topic can be considered in its entirety before proceeding with the remaining Bills.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: It would therefore be convenient and expedient to have them debated back-to-back so that this topic can be considered in its entirety before proceeding with the remaining Bills.

key_points.point: He stated that he was not proposing that the SWDA Bill and the Private Member's Motion be debated together.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: I am not proposing that the SWDA Bill and the Private Member's Motion be debated together.

key_points.point: He said the proposal is for the SWDA Bill to be debated and voted upon first, and after that for the Private Member's Motion to be moved, debated and voted upon.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: The proposal is for the SWDA Bill to be debated and voted upon first, and after that for the Private Member's Motion to be moved, debated and voted upon.

key_points.point: Mr Deputy Speaker directed the Clerk to read the Orders of the Day and Notice of Motion.
key_points.speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
key_points.quote: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Orders of the Day and Notice of Motion.

what_happens_next: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Orders of the Day and Notice of Motion.
